title: 3 Nov-Mental Health & Violence - Manav Foundation
summary: RCBN organised an insightful seminar on Mental Health & Violence in association with Manav Foundation.
description:
RCBN organised an insightful seminar on Mental Health & Violence in association with Manav Foundation. Health & Yoga Guru Ravi Dixit introduced his practical MENTAL framework, emphasising emotional balance, nutrition, time management, awareness and continuous learning.
Our very own RCBN Anne, Sajeeda Maskati, highlighted the importance of recognising mental-health concerns, seeking timely help and creating safer environments through empathy and listening. The panel comprising Dr. Harish Shetty, Rakshanda Inam and Bharathy Tahiliani explored the roots of violence, emotional disconnect, family issues and financial dependence. Key messages included: “Anger is normal, aggression is abnormal” and “Disconnect is often the real problem – so reconnect!” The discussion emphasised communication, financial independence, exercise, yoga, meditation and meaningful relationships as pathways to well-being. Thanks to AKS PP Suresh Gandhi for Rs 1 lakh . Members 35, Manav Found & Guests 115 - total 150
